facts.fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics microdata catalogue, as of 2 July 2026, lists the Demographic and Health Survey 2019-2020 (entry dated 26 June 2025) and the Labour Force Survey 2018 (entry dated 13 June 2025) among its three studies.

facts.fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics runs a microdata catalogue that, as of 2 July 2026, holds three survey studies (MICS 2000, DHS 2019-2020, Labour Force Survey 2018), the latest entries dated June and July 2025.
